R4A-grouse-atv-0002.name: 330 m NE of Henderson Creek
R4A-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: under 30 minutes from a city (estimate).
R4A-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Henderson 8500); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Road: Henderson Creek Road, 5.5 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
12 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
19 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 8 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).
private land only, with the landowner's permission

plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 89 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.26453, -118.76663, where the truck road ends (Henderson 8500); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 1.6 km to the start. Ride: the Henderson Creek Road stretch, 5.5 km one way. About 110 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-14, Region 8. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
